summary: Iteration 24: verified the LinkedIn OAuth redirect-URI fix (backend + frontend). 12/12 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_linkedin_oauth_redirect.py: GET /api/linkedin/auth returns a LinkedIn authorization URL with redirect_uri=https://vnagents.agenticindia.ai/api/linkedin/callback (no 'preview' substring) and scope=openid profile w_member_social w_organization_social; callback returns 400 'Missing code or state' with no params, HTML error page for error=..., and 400 (not 500) for a bogus code; /api/health healthy; agent-login works with Agent@2024! (payload requires both 'agent' and 'password') and returns 401 on wrong password; /api/company-pages returns 5 pages with no _id leakage; /api/linkedin/accounts leaks no access_token/_id. Frontend: /linkedin login + LinkedInAgent load, Settings tab opens, 'Connect LinkedIn Account' opens the LinkedIn OAuth popup whose URL contains the production redirect_uri and w_organization_social scope. /linkedin-search CRM loads with all 7 sidebar nav items (nav-dashboard/pipeline/search/contacts/messages/company_pages/settings) all clickable, Company Pages view renders 5 pages. No 4xx/5xx network calls or console errors observed during frontend runs.

minor.issue: Because LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI contains 'preview' and PROD_DOMAIN is set, the PREVIEW environment now also emits the production redirect_uri. Consequence: OAuth 'Connect LinkedIn' can no longer be completed from the preview URL - LinkedIn will redirect to vnagents.agenticindia.ai and the token will be stored in the production DB, not preview. Recommend deriving the redirect from the incoming request host (request.base_url) or keeping a per-environment env var, so both environments work.

The first branch reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, which is not present in the backend process env (dead code today - verified by log 'LinkedIn OAuth redirect URI: https://vnagents.agenticindia.ai/api/linkedin/callback'). If it ever gets injected with the preview URL it would silently override PROD_DOMAIN and re-break production. Either remove it or gate it explicitly.

State is looked up but never enforced ('Accept the callback even if state is not found'), so CSRF protection is effectively disabled. Bogus code+state returned 400 from the LinkedIn token exchange, which is fine, but state should be validated.
AGENT_PASSWORD still falls back to a hardcoded default when the env var is missing (carried over from iteration 23); fail fast instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Profile avatar renders as a broken image (LinkedIn CDN picture URL expired); no fallback initials/placeholder

integration_issues.issue: Popup opens LinkedIn OAuth with the production redirect_uri, so the connection cannot be completed/verified in the preview environment (token would be written to the prod DB). Also requires https://vnagents.agenticindia.ai/api/linkedin/callback to be whitelisted in the LinkedIn developer app - otherwise LinkedIn will show 'redirect_uri does not match'.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI was hardcoded to the preview host, so on production LinkedIn redirected to a domain that does not serve the prod app. Fix adds _get_redirect_uri() which substitutes PROD_DOMAIN when the configured redirect contains 'preview'. Verified working. Residual risk: the substitution is unconditional, so the preview deployment now also advertises the production callback and can no longer complete OAuth itself; a request-host-derived redirect would fix both environments.
